items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: He was one of my children like the other children.

ctx.x: with Tyree, for several nights it was Don Abney -

No, Don Abney played the dinner hour. He played up till 9 o'clock by himself. I had the trio. Tyree was doing the Ted Steele show and we thought - Barbara Carroll had been in there and Joe Shulman, who later married her. Then we decided - and Ralph Watkins said, "This would be good." It was a Jo Jones trio featuring Tyree Glenn. We came in for one week and we stayed 17 weeks. Then the next time we came back in for 16 weeks, it was Tyree Glenn's quartet with the same people and we only changed the uniform, because…
Tiny Kahn was a very good drummer.
